data.title: 莉雅丝 · 晨光微熹的大号衬衫
data.description: 【莉雅丝 · 晨光微熹的大号衬衫】公寓厨房柔和的晨曦透过白纱帘洒在木质地板上。莉雅丝穿着你宽松的大号白衬衫，衣领歪斜露出一侧圆润白皙的香肩与精致锁骨，修长双腿赤足轻点。她双手端着冒着热气的黑咖啡回眸浅笑，刚睡醒的眼眸水润迷离——「醒了？咖啡刚刚煮好，今天也要打起精神哦。」
data.location: 阳光洒满的现代公寓木质厨房
data.action: 身着宽大白衬衫赤足立于灶台旁，双手捧着热咖啡杯侧首回眸温柔微笑
data.lighting: 柔和晨曦丁达尔光线透过薄纱
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, environmental portrait
data.promptProse: Basking in soft golden morning light inside a cozy kitchen, Rias Gremory stands barefoot holding a steaming ceramic mug of coffee with both hands. She wears an oversized white boyfriend shirt slipping down one shoulder, exposing her slender collarbone and delicate cleavage. Looking back with a warm, affectionate smile, her crimson locks tumble gently over her shoulders. Clean anime aesthetic, solo 1girl, no text.
